query: NVDA guided Q4 above consensus — did the financial press pick up on that?

guidance.notes: Company guided Q4 FY2025 revenue to approximately $37.5B (+/- 2%), above Street consensus of $37.1B at time of guidance.
Company guided Q3 FY2025 revenue to approximately $32.5B, versus analyst estimates of $31.7B at time of guidance.

results.headline: Nvidia Q4 Guidance Tops Estimates; Analysts Raise Price Targets Across the Board
results.body: Following Nvidia's blowout Q3 earnings, at least 15 analysts raised their price targets for NVDA stock. The company guided Q4 revenue to approximately $37.5 billion, versus Street estimates of $37.1 billion. Several analysts noted that data center infrastructure spending shows no signs of slowing despite macro uncertainty.

answer:
[Source: guidance-nvda-001] NVDA issued Revenue guidance of $37.5B for Q4 FY2025 (issued 2024-11-20). Prior analyst estimate was $37.1B.
  Notes: Company guided Q4 FY2025 revenue to approximately $37.5B (+/- 2%), above Street consensus of $37.1B at time of guidance.

[Source: news-nvda-003] Nvidia Q4 Guidance Tops Estimates; Analysts Raise Price Targets Across the Board
Following Nvidia's blowout Q3 earnings, at least 15 analysts raised their price targets for NVDA stock. The company guided Q4 revenue to approximately $37.5 billion, versus Street estimates of $37.1 billion. Several analysts noted that data center infrastructure spending shows no signs of slowing despite macro uncertainty.
